title: Allora II Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Recently remodelled, this impressive 3 story, plus luxurious roof-deck, town home situated in Ruskin Park has 3 King master bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, bunk room, Queen Murphy bed and Queen sleeper sofa.
description_expanded: Description304 W RUSKIN PLACE2 KING, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAElevated Living in Seaside’s Artist ColonyAllora 2 is the exclusive lock-off configuration of the acclaimed Allora townhome, offering the second and third floors along with a spectacular open-air rooftop deck. Located in the heart of Ruskin Park, Seaside’s celebrated Artist Colony, this luxury Seaside vacation rental places you among boutique shops, art galleries, and a serene, tree-lined green space—while remaining just minutes from the sugar-white sands and Gulf-front dining along Scenic Highway 30A.Recently remodeled and styled with Restoration Hardware furnishings, Allora 2 delivers refined coastal living paired with state-of-the-art technology, including an 82-inch Smart TV and integrated Sonos audio throughout the main living spaces.Live Where Seaside Comes AliveFrom concerts and galleries to boutique shopping and dining, Seaside Town Center is right outside your door. When it’s time for the beach, a short walk leads you to Seaside’s private residential beach at West Ruskin Pavilion, part of the largest private beach system along 30A.Second Floor | Gourmet Entertaining & Outdoor LivingA private entrance from Ruskin Park—or a separate rear entrance—leads to a secluded second-floor terrace complete with outdoor dining and a natural gas Weber grill, ideal for relaxed entertaining.Through double French doors, the expansive main living area opens to reveal a show-stopping 82-inch 4K Smart TV with Apple TV, Blu-ray player, cinema surround sound, Sonos system, and high-speed wireless internet. A hall bathroom with shower and a utility closet with a full-size washer and dryer add everyday convenience.The gourmet kitchen is designed for hosting and features a Viking gas range with warming drawers, Northland refrigerator and freezer, microwave, dishwasher, TV, and a full complement of small appliances. Just beyond, the dining room is furnished with a reclaimed elm-wood table seating eight, a Sonos music system, and a queen Murphy bed for added flexibility. French doors open to the front terrace overlooking Ruskin Park and the Fairy Forest.Third Floor | Spa-Inspired Suites & Private TerracesDouble doors on the third floor open to the luxurious king primary suite, complete with a spa-inspired en-suite bathroom featuring a Kohler rain shower and a Tyrrell & Laing freestanding soaking tub for two. The suite also includes a 50-inch Smart TV, Apple TV, walk-in closet, dresser, and access to a private terrace furnished with comfortable seating.Down the hall, a second bedroom offers a king bed that can be configured as two twins if desired, along with a Smart TV, dresser, wardrobe, side chair, and a private en-suite bathroom with a tub/shower combination. A library-style hallway connects the spaces, enhancing the home’s refined, residential feel.Rooftop Deck | Panoramic Views Over 30AA dramatic spiral staircase set over a glass floor leads to the expansive rooftop deck, where sweeping views stretch across Seaside, Seagrove, WaterColor, and the Gulf of Mexico. The deck features a sail-shaded lounge area, comfortable outdoor seating, loungers, a bar-height table, and a Sonos speaker system—creating an unforgettable setting for sunset cocktails and evening gatherings.Smart, Seamless LuxuryIn addition to designer finishes and furnishings, Allora 2 is equipped with cutting-edge, wireless-enabled audio-visual technology throughout, including Samsung Smart TVs, Apple TVs, and multiple Sonos music zones, all easily controlled via the Sonos app.* 5 night stay Spring & Spring Break; 3 night stay Fall; 2 Night stay Winter; not available during summer. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.FEATURES2,766 square feet of luxury living (lock-off configuration)Private Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin PavilionPart of Seaside’s largest private residential beach system on 30AApprox. 352 yards / 4-minute walk to beach access82-inch 4K Smart TV with cinema sound and Sonos in the main living areaTVs and Apple TV throughoutPersonal artwork in the living area (may not be suitable for younger audiences)Steps from The Chapel at SeasidePeacock Alley linens with fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughoutIdeal accommodations for bridal parties and group staysAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayNo pets or smoking permitted 2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. No pets or smokingSTR23-002231
